title: An array index in CHOOSE turns selected blank cells into 0
statement: When an array index_num lifts CHOOSE in dynamic-array Excel, selected empty cells come back as the number 0 rather than as blank references, so ISBLANK over them is FALSE.
basis: One recorded array reading, with ROWS 1 and COLUMNS 2 from observer cells.
inferred: That a scalar index keeps the blank reference is a DnaCalc control, not a recorded reading.

repros.recorded_in: Excel 16.0.20527.20088 Current Channel, Windows 64-bit (NT 10.0.26200), x86-64, AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, en-ZA
